title: SCI.DY.------UNF.PI.
description: Second diagram on page 258 (PR.S(RD)II-12), paired with EXT-DY × SOC-RT-DY above. The crossing diagrams how scientific-dynamics structurally meets unification (positively intended) at the journalism-criticism-of-affinity-interpretation scale the surrounding prose names ('A given observation would find journalists measuring how a particular person functioned with respect to the affinity interpretation that western culture has developed in its own methodology'). SCI-DY (scientific dynamics) crossed with UNF-PI (unification (positively intended)). SCI-DY sits on the left with the subject-arrow; TR (transformation) at upper-center and WO-UNF (world-unification) at top-right with MT-INFO (multi-information), BIA (bi-aitional), and C-RH (composite research) anchoring the right margin as the partner-side upper outputs. SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) at center-left below SCI-DY. EXB-H-OR (establishing high order) at lower-left and PER-VT-U-FUND (perceived vibrational universe fundamental) below as the subject-side downward chain. EXT-FT (extended functionalism) at right-center as the partner-side downward output. UNF-PI sits centrally at lower-center as partner-axis. PER-PHY-U-FUND (perceived physical universe fundamental) at the bottom-right as the bridging-axis downward terminus. Structural argument: when scientific-dynamics is crossed with unification (positively intended), the upper diagonal TR → WO-UNF → MT-INFO → BIA → C-RH is the *journalism-criticism chain* — transformation routes through world-unification into multi-information, then through bi-aitional into composite-research on the partner-side. The chain passes through bi-aitional at exactly the position where journalism's measurement of affinity-interpretation operates — composite-research gets received through bi-aitional. SPT-DY hangs below SCI-DY as the subject's downward output. EXB-H-OR → PER-VT-U-FUND is the subject-side downward chain — establishing-high-order routes through perceived vibrational universe fundamental. UNF-PI → EXT-FT → PER-PHY-U-FUND is the partner-axis's downward chain. The structural argument: journalism's measurement of affinity-interpretation produces 'whether or not a given participation corresponds to an imposed definition of real' precisely because the upper diagonal routes through BIA before reaching C-RH — the form's actual scientific-dynamics gets received only at composite-research through bi-aitional, and the subject's establishing-high-order downward chain only reaches perceived vibrational universe fundamental rather than crossing into unification (positively intended) directly. The form's affinity-interpretation is journalistically measured against composite-research as received through bi-aitional, not against the form's working scientific-dynamics.
